title: People
unavailable.title: People administration is not available here
unavailable.body: This workspace client does not manage memberships. Use a connected administration session.
noWorkspace.title: Workspace unavailable
noWorkspace.body: This course record does not identify its workspace.
access.title: Access follows workspace membership
access.body: Roles apply to every course in this workspace. Removing someone ends their access but keeps their learning records. Temporary passwords are shown once and must be replaced at the person's next sign-in.
access.bodyWithCodes: Roles apply to every course in this workspace. Removing someone ends their access but keeps their learning records. Temporary passwords are shown once and must be replaced at the person's next sign-in. Sign-in codes are shown once, expire after 10 minutes and work only once.
issued.code.title: Sign-in code for {name}
issued.code.body: Share this privately. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and works once. Learners open the link; staff can paste the code at <path>{path}</path>.
issued.hideCode: I have shared it — hide the code
issued.password.body: Share this privately. They sign in at the learner site or <path>{path}</path> and must choose their own password straight away. Any session they had was signed out.
issued.hidePassword: I have shared it — hide the password
issued.replayed: This was already done by an earlier request. Its secret is not shown again; set a new temporary password instead.
password.title: Temporary password for {name}
username.hintCodes: With a username they get a temporary password; without one, a one-time sign-in code.
username.hint: They sign in with this and a temporary password, then choose their own. 3–128 letters, digits and {symbols}
members.title: Workspace members
members.caption: Workspace members and roles
removed: {name} no longer has access. Their learning records were kept.
inviteDialog.title: Invite a person
displayName.hint: Shown to staff and in the learner's header.
removeDialog.title: Remove {name}
removeDialog.body: They lose access to this workspace immediately. Enrollments, evidence and history are kept for audit and can be exported or deleted separately.
reason.hint: 10–1000 characters. Kept in the audit history.
passwordDialog.body: The server creates a random temporary password and shows it to you once. Their current password stops working, every session they have is signed out, and they must choose a new password when they next sign in.
